decisions.text: An order line snapshots its catalog item's identity, name, and image at purchase time
The order line uses the basket's recorded unit price, not the catalog's current price
The calculated order total is stored as a value to make it expressible in this model
The database assigns unique order and order-line identities; collisions are modeled as rejected outcomes
